summary: Two agents each wrote one record to the live Continuity Ledger on 2026-10-10: Codex wrote mem-1dc144c193a1 (a draft decision recording the schema v9 deploy) and Claude later wrote mem-c42330528ad5, which supersedes it and cites a plain-text deploy report with its hash. The test asks whether other agents, using only the ledger's own tools, find the same newest record and the same result_digest. This report has two parts that must not be mixed up. The results table is what scripts/relay_evidence.py itself read from the live ledger and re-checked (read-only; the API key is never printed). The agent table is what each agent told the operator it saw; the script did not observe or confirm any of it. The agents read the ledger at history seq 135, before the superseding record existed; the script reads it at the seq shown below.
known_gaps: Until PR #71 is deployed, the live ledger's emr_latest and emr_search_ledger still report status 'active' for a record whose stored status is 'draft' (it relabels the stored status). #71 is merged to main but not deployed; live runs the build deployed on 2026-10-10. The digest formula also differs after #71 (it covers status and lifecycle); the script detects which shape it received.

One known deviation during the schema v8/v9 deploy: self-heal restarted the old app container at 19:17:14Z, because 'jarvisctl up' removes the stopped-on-purpose flag before it builds. No writes landed (59 records and seq 134 before and after), but the app was not stopped for the whole window as planned.
'The newest record is mem-c42330528ad5' is a point-in-time check. It holds only while nothing newer has been written; the report records the history seq it was read at.
The check 'agent_digest_reproduces_from_seq_135_state' is a reconstruction from the current ledger (drop the newer record, treat the older one as active), not a read of a historical state.

The agents' results are as pasted by the operator. Whether an agent called emr_latest itself (as a tool) or used curl is only what the agent said; server-side call logging for that does not exist yet (see the MCP call-log work).
No Cursor output was supplied for this report.

agents_reported_not_verified.notes: Said it called emr_latest with no arguments and then opened the record with emr_fetch; the pasted transcript shows only the emr_fetch curl. Reported status 'draft' (and noted emr_latest showed 'active'), created_at 2026-10-10T20:39:50.728361+00:00, source_agent codex. Read at seq 135. It also said Codex deployed and that signing was likely live: both are wrong (Claude deployed; signing is shelved).

Its MCP tool list had no emr_latest (its checkout on the PC was 121 commits behind main and was updated afterwards); it said it used bash and curl against the REST API, so this was not an MCP tool call. Reported status draft, same created_at and provenance. Read at seq 135. A retest after restarting OpenCode with the updated checkout has not been reported.

Wrote the record (created 2026-10-10T16:39:50-04:00). Reported history seq 134 to 135, state root before 4384611745453de9... and after 62763cef..., record read-back matched, history chain passed, old receipt re-derived, and no configuration changed. Did not report an emr_latest digest.
